cmd: cat /app/my-sql-query.sql
ls -la /app/ && sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".tables"

sqlite3 --version && sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".schema words" ".schema senses" ".schema synsets" && sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name IN ('words','senses','synsets');"
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words) w, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses) s, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM synsets) y;"

clear; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';" && echo '--- dup wordids:' && sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid FROM words GROUP BY wordid HAVING COUNT(*)>1);" && echo '--- dup wordid+word:' && sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid, word FROM words GROUP BY wordid, word HAVING COUNT(*)>1);" && echo '--- senses FK dangling:' && sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets y ON s.synsetid=y.synsetid WHERE y.synsetid IS NULL;"

clear; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT w.wordid, COUNT(*) FROM words w JOIN senses s ON w.wordid=s.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid)>=2;"
clear; cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite -header < my-sql-query.sql > orig.out 2>orig.err; echo "exit=$?"; head -5 orig.out; wc -l orig.out; cat orig.err
sleep 1; head -5 /app/orig.out; wc -l /app/orig.out
sleep 3; echo MARKER; head -5 /app/orig.out; wc -l /app/orig.out; cat /app/orig.err
WAIT 60
WAIT 120
ps aux | grep -E 'sqlite|time' | grep -v grep

clear; cd /app && time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT w.wordid, w.word, COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets, COUNT(*) AS total_senses, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS dd, COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS dp FROM words w JOIN senses s ON w.wordid=s.wordid JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid)>=2 AND COUNT(*)>=2);"

clear; cat > /app/cand_restricted.sql <<'EOF'
WITH word_agg AS (
  SELECT
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
top500 AS (
  SELECT wordid, word, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids
  FROM word_agg
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
top AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.wordid
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM senses s
  JOIN top500 t ON t.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT
  t.wordid AS word_id,
  t.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets,
  t.total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids,
  tp.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  tp.cnt AS top_synset_sense_co

clear; time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid, SUM(cnt) AS total_senses, COUNT(*) AS total_synsets, COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains, COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids FROM (SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) cnt, syn.domainid, syn.posid FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid) GROUP BY wordid HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid)>=2 AND SUM(cnt)>=2);"

clear; cat > /app/cand2.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ws AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt, syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
word_agg AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2 AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
),
top500 AS (
  SELECT wa.wordid, w.word, wa.total_synsets, wa.total_senses, wa.distinct_domains, wa.distinct_posids
  FROM word_agg wa
  JOIN words w ON w.wordid = wa.wordid
  ORDER BY wa.total_senses DESC, wa.total_synsets DESC, wa.distinct_domains DESC, wa.wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
top AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wordid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM senses s
  JOIN top500 t ON t.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT
  t.wordid AS word_id,
  t.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets,
  t.total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids,
  tp.synsetid

clear; for f in cand_restricted cand2; do for i in 1 2 3; do /usr/bin/time -f "$f run$i: %es" sqlite3 oewn.sqlite -header < /app/$f.sql > /dev/null 2>>/tmp/times_$f.log; done; done; cat /tmp/times_cand_restricted.log /tmp/times_cand2.log
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /app/cand_restricted.sql)" | head -40

clear; cd /app; for f in cand_restricted cand2; do echo "== $f"; for i in 1 2 3; do t0=$(date +%s.%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite -header < $f.sql > /dev/null; t1=$(date +%s.%N); echo "run$i: $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc)s"; done; done

clear; cd /app; for f in cand_restricted cand2; do echo "== $f"; for i in 1 2 3; do t0=$(date +%s.%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite -header < $f.sql > /dev/null; t1=$(date +%s.%N); awk -v a=$t0 -v b=$t1 -v i=$i -v f=$f 'BEGIN{printf "%s run%d: %.3fs\n", f, i, b-a}'; done; done

clear; cat > /app/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH word_agg AS (
  SELECT
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
top500 AS (
  SELECT wordid, word, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids
  FROM word_agg
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
top AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.wordid
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM senses s
  JOIN top500 t ON t.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
)
SELECT
  t.wordid AS word_id,
  t.word AS word,
  t.total_synsets,
  t.total_senses,
  t.distinct_domains,
  t.distinct_posids,
  tp.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  tp.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM top
clear; tr -cd ';' < /app/sol.sql | wc -c; tail -c 15 /app/sol.sql | od -c | head -3

clear; cd /app && t0=$(date +%s.%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > sol_out1 2>sol_err; rc=$?; t1=$(date +%s.%N); awk -v a=$t0 -v b=$t1 -v r=$rc 'BEGIN{printf "exit=%d  time=%.3fs\n", r, b-a}'; cat sol_err; diff orig.out <(sqlite3 oewn.sqlite -header < sol.sql) && echo "WITH-HEADER IDENTICAL"; diff <(tail -n +2 orig.out) sol_out1 && echo "NO-HEADER IDENTICAL"; wc -l sol_out1

clear; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT s.synsetid, COUNT(*) c FROM senses s WHERE s.wordid=17710 GROUP BY s.synsetid ORDER BY c DESC, s.synsetid ASC LIMIT 3;" && ls -la /app/oewn.sqlite && rm -f /app/cand_restricted.sql /app/cand2.sql /app/cand_restricted.out /app/cand2.out /app/sol_out1 /app/sol_err /app/orig.out /app/orig.err /tmp/times_*.log && ls -la /app/

clear; rm -f /app/cand2.err /app/cand_restricted.err; ls -la /app/; echo '===== sol.sql ====='; cat /app/sol.sql; echo '===== final run ====='; t0=$(date +%s.%N); sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /app/sol.sql | head -4; t1=$(date +%s.%N); awk -v a=$t0 -v b=$t1 'BEGIN{printf "time=%.3fs\n", b-a}'
